rows.en: ＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿００６Oh!￥Why, hello there!＝＠１５４＿００７How long were you watching?￥Did you see something￥embarrassing?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０１１Kidding! If it's you,￥I don't mind at all!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０１２Huh? Wait, you've already￥finished training, haven't you?￥Which means...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０１３Oh no!￥Look at the time...!!￥I have to hurry back!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０１６No point if I forget￥the data disks.
＊＊－　Sakaki dropped the disk case,￥　　which broke on the floor!!　－
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０２１Oh, the case is broken,￥so be careful!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０２４Though saying that right now￥isn't very convincing...＝＠１５４＿０２５Anyway, I'd better hurry￥and clean this up.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０２８Maybe I should've let you￥help me after all...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００２I'm so sorry.￥You were helping me, and I￥got you hurt...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００３I can't believe I let a girl￥get hurt...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００４I'm really sorry.＝＠１５５＿００５I've been worn out lately,￥and my focus has been slipping.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００６Maybe it's my workload...￥Back when I was just a comms￥officer, this never happened.＝＠１５５＿００７Since becoming a supervisor￥here, on top of managing￥communications...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００８Revising new documents, and￥organizing and sorting old data.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿００９Checking the candidates'￥training.＝＠１５５＿０１０We're short-handed, so I also￥help Narusawa patrol￥the facility...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０１１Now that I think about it,￥that's quite a lot...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０１３Oh, I'm sorry.￥Telling you all this...＝＠１５５＿０１４Complaining to a candidate...￥I'm a failure as a supervisor.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０１５Huh? Oh, I'm sorry!￥Griping about my job to￥a candidate, of all people...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０１７I thought it was just because￥I'm tired, but it's not only￥that.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０１８I wonder why...￥You're just so easy to talk to.＝＠１５５＿０１９I know you're a candidate,￥but I just can't help it...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０２０Really?￥Hearing that makes me￥feel a little better...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５５＿０２２Well,￥I should get back to work.￥I'm not done yet...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００１Oh, I wonder if this is￥what talking with a little￥brother is like?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００２I'm an only child, so I've￥always kind of wanted￥a brother.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００３Talking with you, I keep￥thinking a little brother might￥be like this... Isn't that odd?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００４Oh, I wonder if this is￥what talking with a little￥sister is like?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００５I'm an only child, so I've￥always kind of wanted￥a sister.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００６Talking with you, I keep￥thinking a little sister might￥be like this... Isn't that odd?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００７I've complained a lot, but this￥job has plenty of fun parts too.＝＠１５６＿００８We get the very latest￥information on Elan here,￥you know?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿００９Thanks to that, I've learned￥much more about Elan than￥before.＝＠１５６＿０１０And there are things I never￥would have known as just a￥comms officer.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿０１１Like the satisfaction of￥knowing my work directly￥helps someone.＝＠１５６＿０１２That makes it all￥really worthwhile.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５６＿０１３Oh no!￥I left those disks I dropped￥all over the floor!＝＠１５６＿０１４I'm going back to clean up,￥so you head back to your room.
